verdict.rationale: pnpm has a documented official CLI with scriptable, non-interactive behaviors: dry-run resolution, automatic frozen-lockfile mode in CI, and an offline flag. An agent can drive it through this documented command surface, but the evidence shows no programmatic library or network API, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. missing for 10: documented programmatic/library API (e.g. a Node module interface), machine-readable API spec, independent corroboration of agent-driven usage.
